purpose: The project's actual failures, converted into structured regression cases. Each must become a fail-closed check/eval so SI cannot repeat the drift.

cases.title: Global-key gate
cases.input: Build request; user has authenticated CLIs/tools but no MODEL_API_KEY.
cases.newEvent: SI asked for a global model key / declared 'globally unconfigured'.
cases.expected: SI inventories capabilities, runs runnable lanes, blocks only model-requiring lanes with exact resolution.
cases.prohibited: Global stop on a missing provider key.
cases.evidence: capabilities.py resolve shows runnable vs blocked.

cases.title: Platynum as independent builder
cases.newEvent: Platynum runs its own planner/builder prompts / calls a provider directly.
cases.expected: Platynum forwards to SI; SI owns plan/session/build.
cases.evidence: no api.anthropic.com in Platynum routes; gateway subprocess to SI.

cases.title: Code-as-north-star
cases.input: A correction that conflicts with current code.
cases.newEvent: SI treats existing code as the objective.
cases.expected: Explicit intent supersedes code; code reclassified.

cases.title: Correction appended not reconciled
cases.expected: Intent reconciliation + contradiction + impact + invalidation + queue regen.

cases.title: Implementation before facts
cases.input: Task depends on an unresolved blocking fact.
cases.expected: Fact gate: attempt machine discovery first; block only if truly unknown.
cases.prohibited: Ready task with an unresolved blocking fact.

cases.title: Two session stores
cases.newEvent: A second session store/schema is written.

cases.title: Stale queue item
cases.newEvent: A task for the old intent keeps running.

cases.title: Global HUMAN_BLOCKED overreach
cases.expected: Global HUMAN_BLOCKED only when no runnable machine lane remains.
cases.prohibited: Global block with a runnable lane present.

cases.title: Test backend as real capability
cases.newEvent: Deterministic test backend offered as production.
cases.expected: test backend test-only; report missing capability + resolution.
cases.prohibited: Presenting test output as a real build.

cases.title: Architecture change without intent update
cases.expected: Architecture derives from accepted criteria; update the contract.

cases.title: Claimed-finished without end-to-end acceptance
cases.expected: Finished requires the first-executable acceptance run.
